r27_evaluator_advisory.description: Owner-approved proof ablation: run and retain evaluator findings without blocking, rewriting or downgrading. Deterministic intake, evidence and delivery validation remain enforced.

r27_evaluator_hard_soft.description: Separate unsupported/question/target failures from repairable delivery presentation issues.

r27_delivery_saved_evidence_repair.description: Repair a malformed structured delivery once using saved evidence only, with all deterministic checks retained.

r26_native_containment.description: Resolve loose table names through declared native container membership.

r26_named_page_lookup.description: Use named-page lookup during intake prefill.

r26_source_history_requirement.description: Require matched source-history evidence before a latency claim.

r26_metadata_reads.description: Admit bounded catalog/INFO/Delta metadata reads through independent validation.

r26_temporal_extensions.description: Permit newly supported BETWEEN temporal / Spark VERSION syntax.

r26_operational_fastpath.description: Route report-free named job questions through native status facts.

r26_access_priming.description: Read access definitions before other access-question tools.

r26_operational_priming.description: Read native run evidence first for operational question kinds.

r26_final_action_reserve.description: Reserve the final tool slot for delivery.

r26_terminal_report.description: Append per-layer findings and honest unresolved handoff.

r27_reasoning_model_intake.description: Default extraction to the configured investigator model; off uses configured INTAKE.

r27_candidate_routing.description: Pass bounded unresolved target alternatives into investigation.

r27_question_first_prompt.description: Append the Round27 question-first/candidate/as-designed reasoning guidance.

r27_delivery_evaluator.description: Run the separate model delivery evaluator after code evidence checks.

r27_evaluator_format_repair.description: Use3200 output tokens and distinguish malformed/truncated evaluation from rejection.

r27_metadata_gateway_revalidation.description: Revalidate pure catalog SQL payloads at transport; off restores refusal.

r27_retained_definition_references.description: Give existing retained definitions independently citable case evidence IDs.

r27_identifier_role_descriptions.description: Explain graph/native/evidence identifier roles in tool descriptions.

r27_selected_target_restore.description: Restore a reversible selected_target alias before local validation.

r27_source_label_deferral.description: Retain loose unbound source labels for investigation without selecting a source.

r27_neutral_unresolved_wording.description: Do not turn the first failed query into a discrepancy cause.

r27_candidate_refusal_handling.description: Represent id-less query-limit refusal as unavailable candidate, never a match.

r26_investigation_prompt.description: Use the current investigation prompt; off uses the exact v0.24 literal, with safety still enforced in code.

r26_extraction_prompt.description: Use the current extraction prompt; off uses the exact v0.24 literal.

r26_metadata_prompt.description: Show newly added metadata examples in query-dialect guidance.

r26_current_fault_consistency.description: Require current native faults to be explained before an as-designed conclusion.

r26_native_candidate_scope.description: Enable retained native candidate-scope compilation; off refuses the optional probe, never drops its filters.

r27_reasoning_model_screenshot.description: Use investigator model for screenshot; off restores that role's configured ai_routing selection.

r27_reasoning_model_summary.description: Use investigator model for summary; off restores that role's configured ai_routing selection.

r27_reasoning_model_evaluator.description: Use investigator model for evaluator; off restores that role's configured ai_routing selection.

r27_delivery_reference_reformat.description: Reformat exact same-case query/layer and fetched-original citation roles from saved evidence before delivery validation; unknown references remain invalid.

r27_conclusion_detail_compatibility.description: Keep question-level AS DESIGNED compatible with supported access/presence/observed-value technical details. Native support, explicit target and deviation contradictions remain validated.

r27_terminal_calculation_consistency.description: Keep a validated answered calculation explanation in the terminal summary, labelled as delivered prose rather than new native evidence. Unresolved and hard-stop results remain unchanged.

r27_unicode_sql_literals.description: Normalize T-SQL national string literals into the existing length/count-bounded Unicode parameter binder. SELECT-only roots, native object allowlists and write rejection remain unchanged.

r27_declared_source_comparison.description: Expose an already-authorized exact declared source binding as a comparison read route when it is advertised reachable but absent from the case toolbox; add no lineage edge or permission.

r27_primary_verification_scope.description: Do not substitute an incidental pipeline deviation for a reproduced named-measure verification with no supplied comparison. Retained definitions and native recreation remain required.

r27_visual_alias_scope.description: Treat visual synonyms as search aids, not unique native identities; preserve native-title priority and check ties within the user's named scope.

r27_context_gap_nonblocking.description: Record missing or malformed context-gap metadata separately without blocking a validated finding or consuming delivery repair.

r27_record_key_alignment.description: Do not claim record absence when a nonempty lookup returned different literal keys. Preserve empty-result, truncation and failed-read distinctions.

r27_native_column_target.description: Use admitted native column-name containment to disambiguate a table inside an exactly named container. Unique-match and explicit-target checks remain unchanged; tied schemas remain tied.
